# Mathias Lynnerup Jakobsen - mathiasjakobsen.dk

> Freelance CTO, software engineer, and technical advisor based in Aarhus, Denmark.

## About

Mathias Lynnerup Jakobsen is the founder of JKBSN ApS (CVR: DK45522717), a software consultancy offering fractional CTO services, hands-on product and software development, and technical advisory for small to medium-sized businesses.

## Contact

- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/mathiasjakobsen

## Services

1. Digital Strategy for SMEs - Technical roadmaps, architecture reviews, and technology selection for small and medium businesses.
2. Hands-on Product & Software Development - Full-stack development, from MVP to production systems.
3. Fractional CTO - Part-time technical leadership on a monthly retainer: strategy, team building, and technical governance without a full-time hire.
4. Technical Advisory (Raadgivning) - Technical due diligence, architecture reviews, technology choice consulting, and team/process optimization.

## Clients

Omsorg A/S, VoiceArchive, Arnsbo Group, Spotify, M2 Film, Fliva, ADRENALINE Studios, 3P Learning.
